results.title: Cinco Tipos de Medo
results.overview: Murilo, a grieving musician, falls for Marlene, a nurse trapped in an abusive relationship with criminal Sapinho. Their fates intertwine with Luciana, a vengeful cop, and Ivan, a lawyer with hidden motives, as five lives collide on an irreversible path.

results.title: Garage
results.overview: A severely depressed young man’s suicide plan is abruptly disrupted by his sister, forcing a raw confrontation neither of them is prepared for. A short film to raise awareness about suicide and mental health.

results.title: Kagitham Padavalu
results.overview: Ram and Godavari's childhood bond grows into love despite their villages' rivalry. After their friends face tragic consequences from family opposition, the couple must confront pressure and social divisions.

results.title: Backyard Sports: The Animated Special
results.overview: It’s Opening Day at Steele Stadium. But team superstar Stephanie ‘Bubbles’ Morgan is in crisis. She’s lost her gotta-have-it, never-play-without-it lucky bubble gum! With just 30 minutes until game time, the Backyard kids embark on a wild mission to track it down and save their season.

results.title: LAMAR
results.overview: A young boy watches his family move through a world that rewards survival over innocence, learning early what it means to grow up.

results.title: Jannah
results.overview: Low-level drug dealer and struggling weekend dad Sami faces the ultimate choice after winning 10 mil. in the lottery. Chased by a criminal network, he must flee Copenhagen with the ticket in one hand and his eight-year-old son in the other.

results.title: It’s All Good
results.overview: After taking care of his intrusive mother for years, Elie is relieved: she is cured. He can finally focus on his own life and falls in love… until his mom’s relapse. Now he has to take care of both the women in his life!

results.title: Preta - Eu Não Ando Só
results.overview: An intimate portrait of Preta Gil, crafted from never-before-seen footage and moving testimonials that reveal her strength in the face of life and illness.

results.title: Missing
results.overview: René, a lonely, insecure, and rebellious teenager, escapes her suffocating parents and the sea of doubts she is drowning in. This sets her on a 2,000-kilometer journey to Ciudad Juárez, where she senses something calling her, and which will also become a revelatory inner journey.

results.title: Sweethearts
results.overview: Suse and Ulla are happy together. They live in the country with Ulla's son Karl and enjoy the summer. One day Tom comes by. Tom is Suse's ex - and he is on his way to a rehab clinic. But over the course of the morning it becomes clear: Tom is not yet really comfortable with the fact that Suse has split up with him. And Suse's hope that Tom has grown up a little bit through the planned rehab is soon dashed.

results.title: The Dysphoria
results.overview: A trans woman performs a Satanic ritual to get a vagina, but unwittingly invites a demonic presence into her home which demands a terrible sacrifice.

results.title: Faim De Vie
results.overview: Mathias, from the Samu social emergency service, teams up with two Samu nurses for one night to deal with a mysterious wave of homeless people suffering heart attacks across the city...

results.title: Happy Hours
results.overview: A freshly divorced photographer finds herself unexpectedly reconnecting with her high school boyfriend, who is now a successful travel writer. The pair of former lovers pick back up where they left off, rekindling their spark, confiding in one another and working through old wounds.

results.title: The Smell of Apples
results.overview: In the insulated bubble of white Apartheid South Africa, Marnus, a sheltered 11-year old boy accuses the grandson of his family’s domestic worker of steeling his fishing rod. A brutal chain of events is set in motion, shattering the illusion of his family’s wholesome facade.

results.title: Rock Springs
results.overview: After her father's death, a grieving young girl moves to Rock Springs, Wyoming with her mother and grandmother, only to discover something monstrous hidden in the town’s history and the woods behind their new house.

results.title: Angels of Tokyo Decadence
results.overview: A high-profile escort finds herself in possession of a mysterious orb that haunts her with a mysterious presence as she confronts the meaning of love.
